text.p: FPA Medical Management Inc., a national physician practice management company, has a definitive agreement to acquire Healthcap Inc. in a stock deal, the companies said Friday.
An FPA spokesman said he could not immediately elaborate on financial terms of the pooling of interests transaction.
FPA, based in San Diego, said the merger would expand its services to Missouri and Nevada and is expected to increase its 1997 revenues to more than $1 billion.
FPA said the merger will be immediately boost earnings through the consolidation of corporate and market operating expenses.
The deal is expected to close at the end of June.
Healthcap, also based in San Diego, provides services to more than 300,000 enrollees, FPA said.
FPA's stock rose 62.5 cents to $22.25 on Nasdaq shortly after midday.
